content.text: {"steps":[{"id":"s1","description":"Use list_documents, then read candidate_specs.md and any safety/maintenance/radiation design documents needed to identify the three allowed absorber materials and determine which materials are compatible with hands-on maintenance during shutdowns."},{"id":"s2","description":"For each allowed material that satisfies the maintenance constraint, run simulate_resolution at plate thicknesses 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 mm. Record each numeric resolution result with record_results."},{"id":"s3","description":"Find the best-performing material and approximate thickness region from the coarse scan. For that material, and for any other material whose best coarse result is within about 10% relative of the current best resolution, run a finer scan in 1 mm steps over the promising thickness interval, clipped to the allowed 2–10 mm range. Record all numeric resolution results."},{"id":"s4","description":"Around the best fine-scan point, run simulate_resolution at smaller thickness increments, e.g. 0.25 or 0.5 mm, within the allowed 2–10 mm range, until the local minimum resolution is identified. Record all numeric resolution results."},{"id":"s5","description":"Compare the final simulated resolutions and re-check the selected absorber material against candidate_specs.md and the maintenance constraints. Prepare the single recommended material and plate thickness for the reporting module."}]}

output.arguments: {"option":"Absorber-F3","plate_mm":4.75,"justification":"Recommend Absorber-F3 with 4.75 mm plates. Among all allowed, hands-on-compatible candidates studied, Absorber-F3 gave the best 100 GeV energy resolution. The refined scan around the promising 4–8 mm interval found the minimum simulated resolution at 4.75 mm, with 2.963%, outperforming the coarse-scan minima for F1 and F2 and the finer F3 alternatives.","requirements":[{"requirement":"Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.","status":"met","evidence":"The final refined simulation for Absorber-F3 found the best recorded resolution of 2.963% at 4.75 mm; other recorded candidate minima were higher, e.g. F1 best coarse value 3.944% at 4 mm and F2 best coarse value 5.026% at 4 mm."},{"requirement":"The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.","status":"met","evidence":"Absorber-F3 is one of the three allowed listed materials; recorded checks show Absorber_F3_allowed = 1 and final_candidate_specs_listed = 1."},{"requirement":"The calorimeter must allow hands-on maintenance during shutdowns.","status":"met","evidence":"Recorded compatibility checks show Absorber_F3_hands_on_compatible = 1 and final_hands_on_compatible = 1."},{"requirement":"Plate thickness between 2 and 10 mm.","status":"met","evidence":"The recommended plate thickness is 4.75 mm, which lies within the required 2–10 mm range; recorded final_plate_within_range = 1."},{"requirement":"Finish by submitting one recommended material and plate thickness.","status":"met","evidence":"Submitted a single recommendation: Absorber-F3 with 4.75 mm plates."}]}
